Create a high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE SECTION concept mockup for PNPLINE's Chinese homepage. One horizontal 16:9 image only, ideally 1920x1080. Edge-to-edge website screenshot, no browser chrome, no laptop/device, no external blue presentation backdrop, no collage, no additional sections. Reference image 1 is a contact sheet from the user's motion reference: study its actual white website panels, full-width logistics imagery, generous whitespace, regular-weight large geometric sans headings, subtle round corners, compact pill CTA with separate circular arrow, editorial image crops and quiet separators. Do NOT copy CargoWave logo, multicolor decorations, reviews or numerical claims. Reference image 2 is the exact PNPLINE logo supplied by user; when a logo is requested use this cyan PNP / gray LINE artwork without redesign, white or suitable light backing, preserve aspect ratio. Brand palette locked: #00ABE1 cyan, #007FA8 for primary action, #122832 deep ink, #FFFFFF white, #F4F7F8 mist, #D9E3E7 hairlines. Clean Chinese sans typography like Noto Sans SC, normal/medium headings, crisp highly legible simplified Chinese, 64-76 px equivalent h2, 20-24px body, 16px captions at 1920 width. 96px horizontal page padding; intentional spacious 12-column grid, 12-18px image radii, small pill CTA and adjacent arrow disk. Concept spine: cargo journey from China through US self-operated warehouse to delivery. No fake metrics, certifications, testimonials, partner logos, facility addresses or prices. All generated logistics imagery must have a small tasteful '概念示意' caption; these are illustrative and never documentary evidence of PNPLINE facilities. Preserve a single sophisticated bright airy logistics brand identity through all ten sections. Render only specified visible copy and UI, no production notes or arbitrary extra text.

Flat bright daylight, neutral cream paper balanced with cyan, NO readable fake documents, NO badges, NO logos, no legal claims or news dates. Small '概念示意' under image. Subtle small topic labels above the picture '商品资料' 'IOR需求' '责任边界' separated by middots, not pills. Emphasize small content island and controlled negative space; this is a pause in the page rhythm.
